query:
SELECT id, name, latin_name, conservation_status
FROM plants
WHERE conservation_status IN ('CR', 'EN', 'VU')
AND (certifications IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(certifications) = 0)
ORDER BY 
  CASE conservation_status 
    WHEN 'CR' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'EN' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'VU' THEN 3 
  END,
  name
LIMIT 30;
